prompt:
<FIRST_FRAME> Continuous, unbroken single shot from a flying camera, with absolutely no scene cuts, no dissolves, no cross-fades and no change of shot; the same tower, hill and city stay continuously visible in every frame. The first frame is taken from the middle of a continuous aerial shot: the camera is already moving in the very first frame, so the motion between the first two frames is already clearly visible and continues smoothly; it never starts from rest, never pauses and never jerks.
Aerial view of a tall observation tower on a forested hill with amusement park rides, a tall thin white mast to its right, a wide dense city and mountains on the horizon, in warm early-morning light.
The camera is already moving in the very first frame and keeps one constant, gentle speed for the whole shot, exactly continuing the motion of the first frame, with no pause, no slow start and no sudden move: it slowly circles to the right around the tower while drifting slightly forward and rising gently, keeping the tower near the center of the frame, so the nearby amusement park rides and trees in the foreground slide steadily to the left and the distant city and mountains behind the tower slide slowly to the right, exactly as in the first frames. Real depth parallax. The warm early-morning light stays almost exactly the same through the whole shot, only becoming very slightly brighter: the same soft golden sunlight, the same pale sky and the same clouds.
The tower keeps exactly the same design throughout: a red and white lattice antenna on top, a small cap, an upper observation ring, angled support struts and a large main observation deck with horizontal bands of windows. The observation deck has no external cranes, arms, gondolas, lifts or scaffolding. The tower, buildings, roads, rides and trees stay rigid and never appear, disappear or change shape. Stable level horizon.
Photorealistic aerial footage of a real place: natural, true-to-life trees with individual leaves and varied shapes, sizes and shades of green; real building facades with real windows, balconies and rooftop details; real thin steel structures, rails and supports on the amusement park rides. Natural, unsharpened detail with soft, realistic edges and natural contrast; no painterly, oil-painting, illustrated or cartoon look, no outline halos, no over-sharpening, no HDR look. Clear, clean air with good visibility. No text, no logos, no aircraft or birds in the frame.
